title: Women Are Convinced That Laws Don’t Apply To Them
description:
An officer observed a vehicle accelerate at a high rate of speed from a parking lot. The vehicle almost hit several pedestrians and parked cars in the process. As a result, the officer immediately initiated a traffic stop on the vehicle. Watch till the end to see the full details of the charges. As the officers were completing some formalities, a couple of unidentified women started arguing with them. The women continued arguing for some more time but it wasn’t captured on camera. Dennis was charged with DUI.
